text:
liz: quick sync: TS/Go SDKs added header negotiation prototype to reduce telemetry double-counting. running small canary, saw mismatch with quota dashboard. anyone free to triage?

omar: saw it. the aggregator still treats comma vs semicolon differently so counts split.

cheng: proposal: normalization at ingestion (split on [,;], key=value or key:val) then dedupe by key preferring newest header. non-breaking and quick.

liz: agree. also we should gate negotiate behind REDWOOD_ROUTE_NEGOTIATE=false by default and flip opt-in docs.

release-bot: Created TKT-9001 to add normalization and to add canary flag for negotiation.

omar: i'll take normalization patch, will add unit tests for mixed header formats.

liz: action items: omar -> aggregator patch, cheng -> SDK flag docs + changelog, infra -> proxy prefer-v2 config. keep this thread for updates.
